item.title: Laminar architecture of visual and auditory responses in the supplementary eye field of macaques
item.description: Using linear electrode arrays in and around the supplementary eye field, this paper compares the prevalence, latency and laminar organization of visual and auditory responses across pyramidal neurons and interneurons.
